limitations: These are provider-direct adapter probes; they did not traverse FastMCP, platform REST authentication, Agent context, or platform audit tracing.
No cache bypass or cache miss instrumentation was available.
ClinVar Allele ID remains unsupported and is rejected before network access; it is not coerced to Variation ID.
An initial SCV ESearch XML attempt was rejected because the provider response contained a DTD; SCV lookup was changed to JSON ESearch, preserving XML DTD/ENTITY rejection for EFetch.
